purpose: Govern one Agent Lee voice/persona identity across bodies while allowing replaceable rendering providers.
interpretationLaw: Formula decimal/base64 output is a ranked encoded state and receives no standalone operational semantics. The domain-policy interpreter consumes measured domain state + verified Formula execution evidence and may emit only the bounded action vocabulary declared by this contract.

definitions.canonical_voice_identity_match: 1 only when requested voicePackageId is agent-lee-voice-one.
definitions.persona_contract_match: 1 only when response identity is bound to canonical Agent Lee Entity Identity Authority/persona contract.
definitions.synthesis_provider_ready: 1 only when the selected rendering provider reports ready without substituting an unauthorized identity.
definitions.playback_verified: 1 only after native playback start/completion evidence.
definitions.interruption_verified: 1 only after stop/cancel prevents the prior turn from continuing.
definitions.memory_headroom_ratio: clamp(1 - processRssBytes/deviceMemoryBudgetBytes,0,1), using observed device budget and process RSS.

policy: VOICE_UNIFORM_ACTIVE requires dimensions 0..4 = 1 and Formula execution evidence. A provider may degrade while identity remains fixed; unauthorized TTS substitution is forbidden. Memory pressure may force VOICE_DEGRADED_PROVIDER or VOICE_BLOCKED.
